title: Theme Park
overview:
Design Your Own Theme Park!

Think you can design and build the greatest amusement park in the world? You select the site, you lay out the rides and attractions. You control every aspect of running a profitable amusement park; from staffing to R&D, (how many corkscrews can be safely crammed into a roller coaster anyway?) Any mistakes, and tourists who populate your park will be sure to let you know. Oh, and that merry-go-round in flames is a clue too.

Theme Park - because Big Business was always meant to be Big Fun!

Features
- Choose from 21 different rides and attractions, five of which you can design
- 11 varieties of shops and concession stands
- Staff your park with mechanics, entertainers, security guards, etc.
- Manage prices and inventories for all your shops and concession stands
- Visit your Bank Manager to view detailed profit and loss assessments
